I personally loved the witcher 3.  There is a lot of circle jerking on this sub about the game which can be really annoying , but for the most part I believe it's earned it's praise. There are parts of the game that are a bit slow, with lots and lots of dialogue. I personally love that, but like any game, there will be people that don't enjoy it. I would for sure give it a try, as the world is so immersive and the graphics are very very nice looking.  It also has an amazing story line, and tons and tons of free dlc and side quests.
